scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --workspace @maelk/api run dev" "npm --workspace @maelk/app run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @maelk/app run build && npm --workspace @maelk/api run build
scripts.test:worker-preview: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run && node scripts/check-worker-preview.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/check-stack-contract.mjs && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm --workspaces run test
scripts.test:security:local: npm run supabase:reset && npm run test:rls && npm run test:auth:postgres
